source_text:
Recipe text:  
1. 选择肥瘦相间、较宽的带皮五花肉。用喷枪把猪皮烧黑；如果没有喷枪，可以把铁锅烧热后让猪皮在锅中摩擦。随后皮朝下放入温水中浸泡 3–5 分钟，再用刀刮掉表面的黑膜。
2. 五花肉冷水下锅，皮朝上焯水。水快开时翻成皮朝下，撇去浮沫，然后盖盖，用最小火煮约 10 分钟。捞出后晾至不烫手，用厨房纸擦干，再切成较大的、大小均匀的方块。
3. 砂锅底部铺上小葱叶。另起锅，将五花肉四周煎至微微焦黄，逼出部分油脂，不要煎过头。将煎好的肉皮朝下放在葱叶上。
4. 用煎肉留下的油，将姜片煎至焦黄，再加入葱段、带皮大蒜稍微煎香，随后加入花椒、桂皮、八角等香料翻炒几下，将香料和油一起倒入砂锅。
5. 冰糖 50g 加清水 30g 炒糖色。冰糖完全融化后转最小火，不停搅拌，熬到出现大泡并呈偏枣红色时离火；继续搅拌至泡沫消失，再加入半碗清水，重新加热至糖完全融化。
6. 将炒好的糖色倒入砂锅，再加入黄酒、生抽、老抽、山楂干、红枣等调料，并加入足量水。
7. 大火烧开后转最小火，锅盖留一条缝慢炖；待汤汁减少、不易溢锅后盖严，继续炖约 1 小时。
8. 加入约 3g 盐；如果颜色不够，可补加老抽。继续炖约 30 分钟。
9. 除红枣外，将葱、姜、蒜及香料等配料挑出，再继续炖约 1 小时，总炖煮时间约 2.5 小时。
10. 转中火收汁，尽量不要大力翻动五花肉。收至汤汁稍微黏稠即可。
11. 如果需要摆盘，可将顶部多余的瘦肉修整掉，使肉块皮朝上平稳摆放。最后将汤汁过滤后继续熬至微稠，淋在肉上。

text_steps.text_en: Char the pork skin black with a blowtorch.

text_steps.text: 随后皮朝下放入温水中浸泡 3–5 分钟
text_steps.text_en: Soak the pork skin-side down in warm water for 3–5 minutes.

text_steps.text: 再用刀刮掉表面的黑膜。
text_steps.text_en: Scrape the black film off the surface with a knife.

text_steps.text: 五花肉冷水下锅，皮朝上焯水。
text_steps.text_en: Put the pork belly into cold water and blanch it skin-side up.
When the water is nearly boiling, turn the pork skin-side down.
Skim off the foam.

text_steps.text: 用最小火煮约 10 分钟。
text_steps.text_en: Cook over the lowest heat for about 10 minutes.
Remove the pork and let it cool until it is comfortable to handle.
Pat the pork dry with kitchen paper.

text_steps.text: 再切成较大的、大小均匀的方块。
text_steps.text_en: Cut the pork into fairly large, evenly sized cubes.
Lay scallion leaves across the bottom of the clay pot.

text_steps.text: 将五花肉四周煎至微微焦黄，逼出部分油脂，不要煎过头。
text_steps.text_en: Fry all sides of the pork belly until lightly golden, rendering some fat, but do not over-fry it.

text_steps.text: 将煎好的肉皮朝下放在葱叶上。
text_steps.text_en: Place the fried pork skin-side down on the scallion leaves.
Use the oil left from frying the pork.
Fry the ginger slices until golden brown.
Add the scallion sections.
Add the unpeeled garlic.
Fry briefly until fragrant.
Then add the Sichuan peppercorns.
Add the cinnamon.
Add the star anise.
Stir-fry the spices a few times.

text_steps.text: 将香料和油一起倒入砂锅。
text_steps.text_en: Pour the spices and oil together into the clay pot.
Add 30 g of water to 50 g of rock sugar.
Cook the sugar to make caramel coloring.
Stir continuously.

text_steps.text: 熬到出现大泡并呈偏枣红色时离火；
text_steps.text_en: Cook until large bubbles appear and the color is reddish-brown, then remove from the heat.
Continue stirring until the foam disappears.
Add half a bowl of water.

text_steps.text: 重新加热至糖完全融化。
text_steps.text_en: Heat again until the sugar has completely dissolved.

text_steps.text: 将炒好的糖色倒入砂锅，
text_steps.text_en: Pour the prepared caramel coloring into the clay pot.
Add the yellow cooking wine.
Add the light soy sauce.
Add the dark soy sauce.
Add the dried hawthorn.
Add the red dates.
Add sufficient water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn the heat to its lowest setting.
Leave a gap in the lid and simmer gently.
Continue simmering for about 1 hour.
Add about 3 g of salt.

text_steps.text: 如果颜色不够，可补加老抽。
text_steps.text_en: If the color is insufficient, add more dark soy sauce.
Continue simmering for about 30 minutes.

text_steps.text: 除红枣外，将葱、姜、蒜及香料等配料挑出，
text_steps.text_en: Remove the scallions, ginger, garlic, and spices, but leave the red dates.
Continue simmering for about 1 hour.

text_steps.text: 转中火收汁，尽量不要大力翻动五花肉。收至汤汁稍微黏稠即可。
text_steps.text_en: Reduce the sauce over medium heat until slightly thickened, avoiding vigorous movement of the pork.

text_steps.text: 可将顶部多余的瘦肉修整掉，
text_steps.text_en: If desired, trim away the excess lean meat from the top.

text_steps.text: 使肉块皮朝上平稳摆放。
text_steps.text_en: Arrange the pork pieces steadily with their skin facing up.
Finally, strain the cooking sauce.
Continue reducing the strained sauce until slightly thick.
Drizzle the sauce over the pork.
